training-deepseek-v3.title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report, Table 1 and introduction
training-deepseek-v3.facts: 14.8T pretraining tokens; 2.664M H800 pretraining GPU-hours, 119K context-extension GPU-hours, 5K posttraining GPU-hours, 2.788M total; 2,048 H800 GPUs for the pretraining cluster; prior research and ablation expenses excluded.

training-deepseek-v4-1-flash.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash technical report, abstract and section 4.2.2
training-deepseek-v4-1-flash.facts: 45T multimodal pretraining tokens; 8B parameters activated during prefill and 16B during decode. Vision-encoder preparation and subsequent posttraining are separate stages.

training-gpt-oss.title: OpenAI gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b Model Card, section 2.4
training-gpt-oss.facts: The gpt-oss-120b training run required 2.1 million H100-hours; gpt-oss-20b required almost 10 times fewer. Exact training-token counts and stage-by-stage posttraining compute are not given.

training-gemma-3.title: Google Gemma 3 Technical Report, Table 2 and section 2.2
training-gemma-3.facts: 27B model: 14T tokens on 6,144 TPU v5p chips. 12B model: 12T tokens on 6,144 TPU v4 chips. Pretraining uses knowledge distillation, with a frozen shared vision encoder.

training-nemotron-3-nano.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano technical report, abstract and section 2.3
training-nemotron-3-nano.facts: Nemotron 3 Nano 30B-A3B pretraining uses 25T text tokens, followed by supervised finetuning and reinforcement learning.

training-nemotron-3-super.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super technical report, abstract and pretraining section
training-nemotron-3-super.facts: 25T text tokens: 20T broad-coverage and 5T higher-quality pretraining, using NVFP4. Context extension and posttraining follow.

training-nemotron-3-ultra.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra technical report, abstract and pretraining section
training-nemotron-3-ultra.facts: 20T text tokens: 15T broad-coverage and 5T higher-quality NVFP4 pretraining, followed by context extension and posttraining with more than ten specialized teacher models.

training-llama-4.title: Meta Llama 4 creator model card, Hardware and Software and Training Data
training-llama-4.facts: Maverick: approximately 22T tokens and 2.38M H100-80GB GPU-hours. Scout: approximately 40T tokens and 5.0M H100-80GB GPU-hours. Figures describe pretraining.

training-mistral-large-4.title: Mistral Large 4 launch: training infrastructure and reinforcement learning
training-mistral-large-4.facts: Trained from scratch on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral European datacenters. Reinforcement learning remained ongoing at preview launch. No complete GPU-hour/FLOP total or teacher-cost breakdown.

training-mistral-duration.title: Euronews firsthand reporting from Mistral Large 4 press conference
training-mistral-duration.facts: Reports Mistral saying training took two months, with a rounded 4,000-GPU count. Official written count of 3,800 is preferred. Calendar duration is approximate; constant allocation and utilization are not established.

training-astra-brockman.title: Greg Brockman interview about Astra, September 4, 2026
training-astra-brockman.facts: Brockman states Astra is the first run trained on more than 100,000 GPUs. This interview does not specify chip type, duration, utilization or a complete stage-by-stage compute total.

aa-mistral-large-4-tokens.title: Artificial Analysis Mistral Large 4 Preview / Step 5 comparison, checked October 8
aa-mistral-large-4-tokens.note: Public table displays all ten index constituents without an estimated-score marker. Counts are rounded weighted per-task averages. Retrieved October 8; this is a held-out supplement, not an October 6 token observation.

aa-mistral-large-4-api-check.title: Authenticated Artificial Analysis API check of the unchanged Le Chonk score
aa-mistral-large-4-api-check.limitations: Supplement verifies one model; it does not refresh the entire catalogue, prices or baselines. API still omits per-task token counts and estimation flag. Authentication key is never stored.
